description: This file defines the ContentCulturePickerService class, which implements IContentCulturePickerService. It provides methods to retrieve content item IDs and localizations based on URL routes, and to set culture preference cookies in an ASP.NET Core application.

classes.name: ContentCulturePickerService
classes.description: Implements content localization and culture selection logic, including retrieving content IDs and localizations from routes, and managing culture cookies.

methods.name: GetContentItemIdFromRouteAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the content item ID associated with a given URL route, checking home route or autoroute entries.

methods.name: GetLocalizationFromRouteAsync
methods.description: Gets the localization entry for a content item based on URL route.

methods.name: GetLocalizationsFromRouteAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all localizations associated with a content item based on URL route.

methods.name: SetContentCulturePickerCookie
methods.description: Sets a cookie to store the user's preferred culture for content localization.
